Research context: sources, puzzles and solutions

THE QUESTION BEFORE INFRASTRUCTURE

What's the same?
What's changing?

The team compares form, length, linguistic formulae, solution presentation and collection design. This requires comparable coded evidence and the context of their books.

A SMALL STRUCTURAL PLAY

A riddle is a proof.
The solution points to this.

"I have teeth and don't eat. What am I?

View the solution and markup

The comb. The identifier designates the riddle document; the solution refers to exactly this document.

Separate sections in the TEI context. Complete artificial sample files are available in the download package.

What is being investigated?

  • Book/Collection: Context and Structure
  • Puzzle proof: text, verse/prose, stable ID
  • Solution: separately capture and assign
  • Metadata: time, source, selection and limits

A similar riddle idea in two books are initially two evidences. Historical dependence is a research question.

CORPUS IS CONSUMPTED

Other questions.
New investigations.

The applicants bring many years of research and publications to riddles and puzzle books. During the three project years there are courses, specific workshops and several conference contributions. Now also corpus analyses become a common tool.

From data to own findings

Can anyone go this way without already knowing our storage system, our computers and our tools?

Who works with? Roles and working rules

Only Leas WiMi-Stelle is financed from the three-year project. The other functions use limited chair time, consulting or external research.

This is how the team works – entry, contributions and protection

Git training, shared tools, understandable commit messages and a reachable representation are part of the entry. Scientific approval, technical access and archive responsibility are different roles.

03 / DEFINITIONS AND WORKING CONDITIONS

What's behind
the data product?

TEI describes the texts and their structure. Git keeps track of changes. GitHub publishes the repo and offers releases and feedbacks. The boxes explain the tools; the process steps show our work path.

From the source to the usable corpus

Separate tool repos provide converters, tests and analyses. They process designated data levels. The complete internal history is not unnoticed in the public publication.

04 / BUILDING THE PUBLICATION OF CONKRET

The repo is:
The publication.

It takes the same care in building up, testing and presenting as any scientific publication. The concept for this arises early – not only the evening before the workshop.

Completed publication concept as markdown ↓

A database service and an independently usable corpus

A query service can complement the corpus. Researchers still need identified, locally usable data and traceable transformations, independently of a running project server.

Full thematic overview
Decision paths and data flows as text

Sources and internal research lead through an early publication concept for examination and curation. The public repo provides released data, rules and examples. Releases are archived independently. Researchers work locally with designated versions and report back corrections or new annotations; their adoption requires testing and maintenance capacity again.

07 / BY PROJECT END

What remains after
Last workshop?

After three years Lea's position ends. A reachable repo alone does not keep the use alive. Understandable data, examples, named versions and a clear return channel help others without further researching the former team.

For university and funding, publication concept, quality control and access to use are part of the scientific result. You need working time.

Maintaining care is a limited commitment. Active expansion, acquisition and completion are other decisions. The project shows what applies; its data remains usable locally.

An API or a frontend complements this offer. The data product should also be preserved and understood when changing services or hosts.

Deepening: Which other care commitments are possible?
